visuals.title: Why Your BSc Subjects Decide the Doors

visuals.alt: Comparison table: Exams Accept Your BSc.
visuals.caption: Compare the listed options.
visuals.heading: Exams Accept Your BSc

rows: IIT JAM (MSc at IITs, plus IISc, NITs and other institutes through result sharing)

Any bachelor's degree in the final year or completed. The paper-wise subject rules sit with each admitting institute's programme. Chemistry programmes usually ask for Chemistry across all three years, and Mathematics programmes usually ask for Mathematics for at least two years.

JAM 2027 is on 14 February 2027 with seven papers: Biotechnology, Chemistry, Economics, Geology, Mathematics, Mathematical Statistics and Physics. It offers about 3,000 seats at 23 IITs and 2,000+ more elsewhere. Applications opened on 11 September 2026 and were extended to 19 October 2026.
CUET PG (MSc and other PG seats at central and many state universities)
Any bachelor's degree, final-year students can apply, no age limit. Each university then sets its own subject rules.

The 2026 cycle had 4.11 lakh registrations, 157 subjects and 198 participating universities. NTA has announced the 2027 tests from 1 March 2027. The 2026 application window ran from 14 December 2025 to 14 January 2026.
NIMCET (MCA at NITs)
A bachelor's degree of at least three years with Mathematics or Statistics as a subject, or a BE/BTech, with 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwD). Final-year students can apply.
NIMCET 2026 was on 6 June 2026 for about 1,300 seats at 11 NITs and 2 IIITs. A BSc with maths is the natural entry. The 2027 brochure was not out at the time of writing.
GATE
The official GATE 2027 table lets you appear in the third year of a three-year BSc or after completing it.

GATE 2027 registration closes on 5 October 2026 (12 October with a late fee) and the papers run from 6 to 21 February 2027. Appearing is not the same as being hired: engineering-post PSU advertisements and many M.Tech seats name BE/BTech, so read each notice before you plan around a GATE score.
UGC NET and CSIR NET (JRF, Assistant Professor, PhD)

UGC NET asks for a master's degree at 55% (50% for reserved categories). A four-year bachelor's at 75% (5% relaxation for reserved categories) opens JRF and PhD admission only, and the bulletin states that such candidates are not eligible for Assistant Professor posts.

A plain three-year BSc alone does not qualify. UGC NET June 2026 covered 85 subjects, ran from 22 to 30 June 2026 and set the JRF age limit at 30. CSIR NET lists a master's or a four-year BS/BE/BTech/B.Pharm/MBBS route, so read the CSIR bulletin for the marks rule.
CAT and other MBA entrances
A bachelor's degree with 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD), final-year students included, and no age limit for CAT.
Any BSc subject is accepted. The subject only matters later, for which MBA specialisation and which employer you can target. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee an IIM shortlist.
Physics
Physics (PH) paper
CSIR NET Physical Sciences. IFS accepts Physics. NIMCET if Maths or Statistics is also on the degree.
Chemistry
Chemistry (CY) paper
CSIR NET Chemical Sciences. IFS accepts Chemistry. Pharma QC and QA hiring.
Mathematics or Statistics
Mathematics (MA) or Mathematical Statistics (MS) paper
NIMCET for MCA. SSC Junior Statistical Officer with Statistics. IFS accepts both. CSIR NET Mathematical Sciences.
Botany or Zoology
Only the Biotechnology (BT) paper, and its rules vary by institute
CSIR NET Life Sciences. IFS accepts both. CUET PG subject papers at central universities.
Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry
Biotechnology (BT) paper
CSIR NET Life Sciences. Not on the IFS subject list. Pharma, biotech and clinical-research entry roles.
Computer Science or IT
No JAM paper for it
NIMCET for MCA (needs Maths or Statistics in the degree). Direct software jobs. Not on the IFS subject list.

blocks.heading: Listed Online That Need a Different Degree
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Options listed online that need a different degree

rows: ISRO scientist after BSc

The ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC' advertisement of August 2026 asked for a BE/BTech in Electronics, Mechanical or Computer Science with at least 65% marks. A BSc alone does not qualify for these posts.
College lecturer after BSc
Assistant Professor eligibility needs a master's degree with UGC NET. A four-year bachelor's at 75% opens JRF and PhD only, not the lecturer post.
CSIR-NET straight after a three-year BSc
CSIR-NET June 2026 listed a master's degree, or a four-year BS, BE/BTech, B.Pharm or MBBS route, each with a marks rule in the bulletin. A plain three-year BSc is not on that list.
PSU engineer through GATE
You may sit GATE after the third year, but many engineering-post advertisements name BE/BTech. Read the specific notice, not the coaching brochure.
Teacher in a government school
It needs a B.Ed and the relevant teacher eligibility test. Check the current NCTE rules on the one-year and two-year routes.

Junior research fellow (CSIR JRF, after MSc and NET)
₹37,000 a month, about ₹4.44 lakh a year, plus a ₹20,000 yearly contingency grant
CSIR-HRDG guidelines effective 1 March 2023. It rises to ₹42,000 a month from the third year (SRF). You reach it only after a master's degree and a NET/JRF rank.

blocks.heading: Long an Msc Takes to Pay Back
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: How long an MSc takes to pay back

rows: ₹1 lakh a year
about 7.5 years
The MSc rarely pays for itself on salary alone. Do it only if the role needs the degree.
₹2 lakh a year
about 3.8 years
Worth it when the target role clearly pays this much more with an MSc.
₹3 lakh a year
about 2.5 years
Strong case, if the uplift is verified from real job postings and not a brochure.
₹4 lakh a year
about 1.9 years
Rare at the start. Treat it as a best case, not a plan.
